name: humanfia-humanize
description: Native Humanize app and tmux TUI workflows for Codex and DSH, with reusable Python flows.

interface.shortDescription: Dynamic flows with the native Humanize app or tmux TUI
interface.longDescription: Choose or author Python workflows as needed. The native Humanize app shows desktop runs; SSH and terminal runs open its official TUI in a named tmux session. Includes cancellation, resumption and curated reuse.
defaultPrompt: Use Humanfia Humanize to complete this task with a dynamic workflow.
